meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按 Dieter Rams 的十项“好设计”原则审计设计：逐项打分（0–3）并给出证据，得出 NEW／REFINE／REDESIGN 判定，最后生成一条可直接执行的 /make-plan 提示词。产出范围、证据、评分卡、判定和交接文件。
howto.when: 当你说“审计这个设计”“设计评审”“这个 UI 好不好”等，或要求做会导向设计计划的批评时触发。对尚不存在的设计，直接进入新建流程。

say.text: 按 Rams 十原则审计这个设计并打分。
say.note: 会生成范围、证据、评分卡、判定五份文件。

say.text: 对照 Rams 原则评审这个 UI，该精修还是重做？
say.note: 给出判定与最高杠杆改动清单。

say.text: 审计首页设计并把结论整理成 /make-plan 提示词。
say.note: 得到可直接粘贴到下一会话的完整计划。

howto.what_en: Turns Claude into an auditor scoring a design 0–3 per Dieter Rams principle with evidence, deciding NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN, and emitting a /make-plan prompt. Produces scope, evidence, scorecard, verdict, handoff files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "audit this design", "design review", "is this UI good", or ask for a critique leading to a plan. If no design exists yet, it goes straight to NEW verdict.

say_en.text: Audit this design against Rams' ten principles and score it.
Review this UI against Rams—refine or redesign?
Audit the homepage and turn the results into a /make-plan prompt.
